boundaries: Publication establishes publication/attribution only, not the truth of underlying client claims.
Communications work does not imply adverse status, wrongdoing, knowledge or coordination.
Source-family republications are not independent corroboration merely because multiple outlets carried them.
Earlier captures are versioned and never silently overwritten.

source_families.independence_rule: downstream family members are not independent corroboration

source_families.source_basis: press-note/source material unless separate newsroom reporting is established

source_families.role_boundary: owner, financier, manager and brand remain distinct roles
portfolio/management statements do not establish asset ownership or financing

mirror_policy: Public GitHub receives only public-safe metadata and evidentiary boundaries through protected PR workflow. Private source bodies, Gmail IDs, Drive locators and privileged/private material remain outside this projection.
